title: FlowIntel, a threat intelligence case management platform, contains an information disclosure… (CVE-2026-133844)
description: FlowIntel versions prior to 4.1.0 have an information disclosure vulnerability in the case serialization logic. Authenticated users with read access to a case could receive connector metadata belonging to other users or organizations, including URLs, descriptions, UUIDs, and potentially API credentials. This exposure crosses organizational boundaries and leaks sensitive connector infrastructure details.
